overall.verdict: Desktop-dark is a coherent, high-trust operator console with a real one-scale bar language and excellent Pay/Sovereignty/Desk craft, but it still ships as a protocol workbench: empty faucets, credit sliders, and hex IDs sit in the first-money path. It would satisfy hubs and DeFi natives before it would onboard Maya, Lena, or a freelancer who needs a $20 invoice.
priority_fixes: Make spendable/enforceable vs promised the single hero everywhere; one Cover $90 CTA from Home, Account, Manage, Sovereignty.
First-run money-in: hide faucets/credit exams; Amount-on-receive invoice; contacts not raw 0x on Pay.
Cross-swap as a two-step wizard with one USD fee; disable Swap until inbound capacity exists.
Receipt/Activity: one event, shareable PDF+proof pack, no contradictory background balances.
Keep Desk/Jump/Lending/Ownership behind Comfort; default Home is Pay/Receive only.
